If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.

If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism.

If sentiment swings sharply from positive to negative within 5 days, reduce forecast by 1–2% in the 16–30 day horizon to correct for sentiment reversal.

If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and price is trending upward, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for late horizon (21–30 days) to capture momentum.

If sentiment is neutral and price is trending downward, subtract 0.5–1.0% from forecast for late horizon to avoid overcorrection.

If sentiment is positive but price is declining, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% in mid horizon to align with sentiment-price divergence.
